DartForge - Dart to JavaScript compiler
Usage: dartforge compile-js <input.dart> -o <dir> [--sdk <lib>] [--packages <cfg>] [--timings]
       dartforge dev <input.dart> -o <dir> [--packages <cfg>] [--sdk <lib>] [--interval <ms>] [--once]
       dartforge serve <input.dart> -o <dir> [--web <dir>] [--port N] [--packages <cfg>]
       dartforge build [<input.dart>] [--root <dir>] [--plan] [--compare] [--release] [--strict] [--workers N] [--write-cache <dir>] [--dart <exe>] [--state]
       dartforge aot|abi-info ...  (build with --features native)
       dartforge run|reload <input.dart> ...  (build with --features jit)
       dartforge export-target <directory>  (runtime and sysroot for cross AOT)
       dartforge pack <destination>  (the distribution: executable, runtime, SDK, linker)
       dartforge analyze [--format=json] [--all] [<dir|file>]  (the JSON of dart analyze)
       dartforge format [-o write|show|json|none] [--set-exit-if-changed] [-l N] <files|dirs>  (dart format 3.6.2)
       dartforge test [<file|directory> ...] [--name <regex>] [--sdk <lib>] [--packages <cfg>]
       dartforge pub get [--offline] [--directory <dir>] [--sdk <lib>] [--sdk-version <version>]
       dartforge macros <input.dart> [--materialize] [--shape 3.6|current] [--dart <exe>]

compile-js emits one ES module per library under the DDC contract.
dev keeps the session alive and recompiles only what the edit affects.
